A selection of labs from the core Data Science and Analytics sequence. These are short, focused exercises rather than full projects.

## DSAN 5000: Data Science Foundations (Python)

- Cleaning tabular data
- Regression fundamentals
- Classification and feature selection
- Network analysis with NetworkX

## DSAN 5100: Probabilistic Modeling (R)

- Conditional probability and continuous distributions
- Markov chains (cave, maze and stock-market examples)
- Time series

## DSAN 5200: Data Visualization

- Interactive charts with Plotly and Altair (including Hong Kong hospital wait times)
- Shiny dashboards
- Geospatial maps
- Network visualization in Gephi
- Time series and Tableau

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
## Project info
- **Course:** DSAN 5000, 5100 and 5200, Georgetown University
- **Date:** Fall 2025 to Spring 2026
- **Team:** Individual labs
- **Tools:** Python, R, Quarto, Plotly, Altair, Shiny, Tableau, Gephi, NetworkX


:::
